events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, created by TEMPTATIONS with Heidi Gardner.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus games for chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: TEMPTATIONS and Mars both describe the physical pop-up as free and publish the same Sept. 17–19, noon–6 PM schedule. No advance RSVP requirement is published. Samples and prize merchandise are promotional and may be limited by supply.
events.practical_notes: Walk in at 213 Bowery from noon–6 PM on Sept. 17, 18 or 19. Go earlier if free treats or prize merchandise are the priority.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation celebrating the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, refreshments, giveaways and interactive moments.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ samples, refreshments and croissants, plus scratch-off prizes while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The organizer's live Eventbrite page confirms Sept. 17, noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle and advertises free giveaways. The page provides a registration/ticket path, while multiple current listings describe consumers as able to stop by; no organizer-selection or approval step is stated. Promotional items are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social and digital channels.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, Sept. 17 from noon–6 PM. The first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample, so arrive early for that offer.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-inspired Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tincture sampling, tongue readings, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day are advertised to receive a free mini Apothékary tincture; visitors can sample tinctures and kakigori is offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: Apothékary's organizer Eventbrite listing confirms the address and date-specific hours: Friday 1–9 PM; Saturday and Sunday 9 AM–9 PM. The Eventbrite registration path is live, but the listing emphasizes first guests in line rather than an approval process. Free minis and kakigori are supply-limited; the 20% retail discount and gift-with-purchase are separate purchase offers.
events.practical_notes: For the free mini tincture, target opening time because only the first 50 guests each day are advertised to receive one.
